sections.section_title: I/Os state retention during standby mode
sections.text_helper: Section 11.3.15 "I/Os state retention during standby mode" in chapter 11 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 347.
sections.section_content:
In the Standby mode, the I/Os are by default in floating state.
If the IORETEN bit in the PWR_IORETR register is set, the I/Os state is sampled during
standby entry. The state of I/Os is applied to the pin via pull-up and pull-down resistors. The
pull-up and pull-down resistors remains applied after Standby wake-up until the IORETEN
bit in the PWR_IORETR register is cleared by software.
